description: Expectations of conformance/selftest.mjs: for each fault of the stub, the exact tests that must fail. Reviewed by hand; the self-test also checks that every title exists.
shapeTests: a body with missing required fields returns validation items
a caller without the permission of a change is refused with 403 Forbidden
a caller without the permission of a read is refused with 403 Forbidden
a change without If-Match returns 428 and a stale one returns 412
a declared sort property is accepted and an undeclared one is rejected
a disallowed method returns 405 with an Allow header
a host principal naming a nonexistent tenant also gets Forbidden
a host principal with the switching permission needs a tenant, and acts within the one it names
a host principal without a tenant context gets TenantRequired
a host principal without the switching permission cannot send a tenant header
a limit outside 1 to 200 is a validation error for the parameter
a malformed body returns a validation error with a Malformed item
a refused request produces a denied entry, and the response is the same 403
a refused tenant switch produces a denied tenantSwitch entry in the named tenant's log
a tenant header naming a nonexistent tenant is also a tenant mismatch
a tenant header that differs from the token is a tenant mismatch
a tenant header that is not a UUID is a validation error
an error is localized by Accept-Language and the code does not change
an error response carries the trace id of the request's traceparent
an unauthenticated request is 401 before any permission check
an unauthenticated request returns 401 with WWW-Authenticate: Bearer
an unknown path returns 404 problem details
an unsupported filter property returns an UnknownValue item for the parameter
an unsupported language falls back and still names the language used
another tenant cannot see the entry, and its identifier looks like a nonexistent one
another tenant's entity looks exactly like a nonexistent one
the resources operation needs no authentication and rejects a malformed culture
the same key and body return the original result, another body returns 422

crossTenantRead: another tenant's entity looks exactly like a nonexistent one
crossTenantList: another tenant cannot list the entity
ignoreTenantHeader: a tenant header naming a nonexistent tenant is also a tenant mismatch
a tenant header that differs from the token is a tenant mismatch
nonUuidHeaderAccepted: a tenant header that is not a UUID is a validation error
unknownTenantNotMismatch: a tenant header naming a nonexistent tenant is also a tenant mismatch
hostWithoutTenantAllowed: a host principal with the switching permission needs a tenant, and acts within the one it names
a host principal without a tenant context gets TenantRequired
hostHeaderAllowed: a host principal naming a nonexistent tenant also gets Forbidden
a host principal without the switching permission cannot send a tenant header
a refused tenant switch produces a denied tenantSwitch entry in the named tenant's log
hostUnknownTenantNotFound: a host principal naming a nonexistent tenant also gets Forbidden
noWwwAuthenticate: an unauthenticated request returns 401 with WWW-Authenticate: Bearer
no405Allow: a disallowed method returns 405 with an Allow header
noMalformedItem: a malformed body returns a validation error with a Malformed item
acceptsEmptyBody: a body with missing required fields returns validation items
ignoreUnknownFilter: a declared sort property is accepted and an undeclared one is rejected
a limit outside 1 to 200 is a validation error for the parameter
an unsupported filter property returns an UnknownValue item for the parameter
noPermissionCheck: a caller without the permission of a change is refused with 403 Forbidden
a caller without the permission of a read is refused with 403 Forbidden
a refused request produces a denied entry, and the response is the same 403
accessCacheable: the access endpoint lists the caller's own permissions, sorted, and is not cacheable
ignoreCursor: following nextCursor returns every item once
noLimitValidation: a limit outside 1 to 200 is a validation error for the parameter
noTotalCount: totalCount is present only when includeTotal is true
noEtag: a change with the current version succeeds and returns a new version
a read returns the version as a property and as a strong ETag
an update records exactly the changed property with its old and new value
noIfMatchRequired: a change without If-Match returns 428 and a stale one returns 412
idempotencyIgnored: the same key and body return the original result, another body returns 422
noContentLanguage: an error is localized by Accept-Language and the code does not change
an unsupported language falls back and still names the language used
wrongResourcesCulture: the resources operation serves the culture, with a region falling back to its language
noAudit: a create produces an entry with the actor, tenant, resource and trace id
a host principal acting within a tenant produces a tenantSwitch entry for that tenant
a refused request produces a denied entry, and the response is the same 403
a refused tenant switch produces a denied tenantSwitch entry in the named tenant's log
an update records exactly the changed property with its old and new value
another tenant cannot see the entry, and its identifier looks like a nonexistent one
noDeniedAudit: a refused request produces a denied entry, and the response is the same 403
a refused tenant switch produces a denied tenantSwitch entry in the named tenant's log

a refused tenant switch produces a denied tenantSwitch entry in the named tenant's log
auditLeakAcrossTenants: another tenant cannot see the entry, and its identifier looks like a nonexistent one
auditWritable: the log has no operation that creates, changes or deletes an entry
wrongTraceId: an error response carries the trace id of the request's traceparent
